name: PanOSP
tagline: Lightweight, configurable AOSP-style quick settings panel for Android.
blurb: PanOSP is an open-source Android quick settings and notification panel inspired by AOSP.
description:
PanOSP is an open-source Android quick settings and notification panel inspired by AOSP.

It is designed as a lightweight alternative to manufacturer control centers and can be especially useful on devices where manufacturer system applications have been removed or disabled.

PanOSP provides:
• AOSP-style quick settings
• Configurable tile selection and ordering
• Multiple tile pages
• Brightness control
• Notification display
• Configurable panel appearance
• Customizable tile colors and corner radius
• No advertising
• No tracking
• No unnecessary network access

Supported languages:
English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and German.

PanOSP uses Android accessibility and system APIs to display its panel and interact with system controls.

Some controls depend on Android or manufacturer restrictions. Certain advanced actions may require additional system permissions, and behavior can vary between devices and Android implementations.

Minimum Android version: Android 13.
